facts.fact: The IPDCP, Togo's data protection instance, issued a communique opening the declaration process for CCTV devices.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel (IPDCP)

facts.fact: The IPDCP says declaration of CCTV devices is launched under law 2019-014 of 29 October 2019, articles 6, 8 and 10.
The IPDCP launched the declaration and authorisation process for CCTV, with a standard form and a compliance pictogram, and no decision on a controller.
